newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron lukewarm on naphtha project.
newsitem.headline: Petron lukewarm on naphtha project.

text.p: Petron Corp chairman Monico Jacob said on Monday the company was unlikely to take an equity stake in a proposed naphtha project to be pioneered by the petrochemical arm of the Philippine National Oil Co.

"We are basically an oil refiner and we think it would be better if we stick to our core competencies," Jacob told reporters when asked whether the company was participating in a consortium being set up by PNOC-Petrochemical Development Corp (PPDC) to build a naphtha cracker.
However, he said Petron would still be interested in supplying the naphtha requirements of the naphtha cracker.
The Philippines does not have a naphtha cracker plant at present.

Jacob said Petron had tapped two U.S-based firms to conduct separate studies on the viability of a new refinery and an aromatics centre. The studies will be completed within five months. -- Manila newsroom 63 2 8418939 fax 8176267
